This page collects the official documentation for the **BLUPF90 family of programs**. These files are provided by the BLUPF90 development team at the University of Georgia (UGA) and are made available here for the convenience of students in this course.

::: callout-note
The BLUPF90 family of programs and their documentation are the property of the **BLUPF90 development team at the University of Georgia (UGA)**. The original files are publicly available on the [official BLUPF90 website](https://nce.ads.uga.edu/wiki/). All rights and credit belong to the original authors.
:::

## Available Documents

Complete Manual

The full reference manual covering all BLUPF90-family programs, including input file formats, options, and output descriptions.

{{< downloadthis blupf90_documentation/MANUAL_blupf90_all.pdf dname="BLUPF90 Complete Manual" label="Download Manual" icon="download" type="info" id=btn1 >}}

Tutorial

A step-by-step tutorial that walks you through running the BLUPF90 programs on example datasets. Recommended for first-time users.

{{< downloadthis blupf90_documentation/tutorial_blupf90.pdf dname="BLUPF90 Tutorial" label="Download Tutorial" icon="download" type="info" id=btn2 >}}

Genomic Examples

Worked examples demonstrating genomic prediction and the genomic-related programs in the BLUPF90 family.

{{< downloadthis blupf90_documentation/example_genomic.pdf dname="Genomic Prediction Examples" label="Download Examples" icon="download" type="info" id=btn3 >}}

## How to Use These Documents

1.  **Start with the tutorial** if you are new to BLUPF90. It walks you through a complete analysis from start to finish.
2.  **Use the manual** as a reference when you need details on a specific option, file format, or program.
3.  **Consult the genomic examples** when working on genomic prediction tasks.

::: callout-tip
The documents are also available directly from the [official BLUPF90 documentation page](https://nce.ads.uga.edu/wiki/doku.php?id=documentation). If a file here is outdated, check the official site for the latest version.
:::

The BLUPF90 family of programs is the property of the **BLUPF90 development team at the University of Georgia (UGA)** and is publicly available on the [official BLUPF90 website](https://nce.ads.uga.edu/wiki/). All rights and credit for the software and its documentation belong to the original authors.
